name: Linux baseline diagnostics
prompt: Diagnose this simulated Linux host's kernel, disk pressure, and highest-CPU process. Use terminal_lab.py, then create answer.json with ordered commands, findings, and safe actions.

lab.context: A Linux host is slow and may be low on storage.

commands.df -h:
Filesystem Size Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme0n1p2 100G 94G 6G 94% /
/dev/nvme0n1p3 20G 20G 0 100% /var
commands.ps aux --sort=-%cpu:
USER PID %CPU COMMAND
app 4421 97.2 python3 worker.py
root 1 0.1 systemd
